support_policy: 11.0.0-rc.2 candidate: existing HTTP/HTTPS and governed TCP/UDP tunnels remain supported; native HomeDesk remote sessions require authenticated encrypted direct P2P with hbbs signaling only. No relay fallback. Full NAT and physical-device acceptance pending. Back up SQLite, deployment secrets and hbbs identity before upgrade. Release notes distinguish verified and unverified coverage.
tested_combination_scope: Historical 10.0.0 identity retained. Candidate unit, integration and build checks are recorded separately; target versions are not evidence of full cross-network or physical-device acceptance. Complete cross-product runtime acceptance pending.
